mapper.select: SELECT rule_id, category_id, keyword, synonym, match_type, weight, hit_count, status, effective_time, expire_time, create_time, update_time FROM rule_keyword WHERE status = 1 AND (effective_time IS NULL OR effective_time <= NOW()) AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time >= NOW()) ORDER BY category_id ASC, weight DESC

SELECT rule_id, category_id, keyword, synonym, match_type, weight, hit_count, status, effective_time, expire_time, create_time, update_time FROM rule_keyword WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1 AND (effective_time IS NULL OR effective_time <= NOW()) AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time >= NOW()) ORDER BY weight DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rule_keyword WHERE status = 1 AND (effective_time IS NULL OR effective_time <= NOW()) AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time >= NOW())
